item.title: David Fincher Details The “Clusterf*ck” Of Making ‘Mindhunter,’ Says Grueling 90-Hour Workweeks Left Them Nearly “Quadriplegics” By Season 3
item.description: If you’ve followed all the reporting on David Fincher ’s “ Mindhunter ”—much of which we covered intensively— and the difficulties of making it, the reasons there’s no Season 3 make perfect sense. For one, Fincher never intended to be the showrunner, but ultimately found himself saddled with that responsibility. The 90—hour work weeks required to pull it off were all-consuming, the production challenges were enormous, and worse, the series cost an exorbitant amount of money to make—so much so that the viewership simply couldn’t justify the price tag.
